item.description: This folder is a prerequisite step that must be completed before running the Feature Onboarding workflow (folder 04). It uses the Control Plane API to register a catalog item for an OGC Feature dataset — specifically the Godavari basin vector dataset. The catalog entry establishes the asset identity and metadata needed by downstream onboarding and publishing steps.

item.name: 04 · Feature Onboarding · Provider

request.description: Job: presigned URL generation. resourceId = catalog item id created in Control Plane.

Body → binary → select CDPG-At-IISc_Dataset_862026.gpkg (Godavari basin, 294,912 bytes – the file shared by the dev team). No Authorization header – the signature is in the URL. URL expires 5 min after step 03, so run 03 → 04 back to back. Single PUT works only for files < 5 MB; larger files use multipart upload (not in this collection yet).
Re-send until status is 'successful' or 'failed'.
